tools.name: hirehop_get_current_user
tools.description: Show the connected HireHop user's ID, company ID, name, email and default depot. Uses the authenticated current-user endpoint; excludes account settings and credentials.

tools.name: hirehop_list_depots
tools.description: List depot IDs, names and whether each is virtual. GET /php_functions/get_depots.php.

tools.name: hirehop_search_jobs
tools.description: Search rental jobs and open/closed projects with customer, company, venue or job-name filters. Can filter late returns, money owing or jobs needing an invoice. Returns one page and the vendor's totals; follow pages for a complete report. Dates use depot-local calendar dates.

tools.name: hirehop_get_job
tools.description: Read one rental job's details using its numeric job ID from hirehop_search_jobs. GET /api/job_data.php; returns customer, dates, status and the details available to your user.

tools.name: hirehop_get_project
tools.description: Read a project's details, customer, managers, dates and status. Use its numeric project ID from hirehop_search_jobs. GET /php_functions/project_get_data.php.

tools.name: hirehop_list_project_jobs
tools.description: List a single page of the jobs in a project, with vendor totals. Use subsequent pages for the full project. GET /php_functions/projects_jobs_list.php.

tools.name: hirehop_list_contacts
tools.description: Read or search customer, delivery-address and supplier contacts. One page, with vendor paging totals. Hidden/deleted contacts are excluded. GET /modules/contacts/list.php.

tools.name: hirehop_list_products
tools.description: List rental products or tracked sales products and their categories, IDs, names, part numbers and status. This is a catalog, not a date-specific availability report. One page with vendor totals. GET /modules/stock/asset_assign_list.php.

tools.name: hirehop_list_notes
tools.description: Read a page of notes belonging to a job, project, rental inventory product (stock) or asset. Sales inventory notes are not included. Notes can contain HTML. GET /php_functions/notes_list.php. This tool never creates or changes notes.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "hirehop_get_current_user" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: hirehop_get_current_user, hirehop_list_notes · Private data: hirehop_get_current_user, hirehop_list_contacts · Public sink: hirehop_get_current_user.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: hirehop_get_current_user, hirehop_list_notes · Private data: hirehop_get_current_user, hirehop_list_contacts · Public sink: hirehop_get_current_user

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
